cohort: The study included 345,756 singleton births in Massachusetts with a gestational age of at least 23 weeks, born between 2004 and 2010.
finding: Maternal fertility group was not an independent predictor of infant length of stay and costs; instead, prematurity and birthweight were the primary driving factors in resource utilization.
birth_weight: N/A (birthweight was analyzed as a predictor, but no specific inclusion range was mentioned)
